current_layer: engineering-governance / independent hostile audit of Gate evidence provenance verifier
mainline_integration_status: none (not wired into runtime, scheduler, Gate4, Gate5, Route C, admission, or live paths)

source_hash_verification.method: independent sha256sum on disk vs readback.json claimed hashes
source_hash_verification.note: no FUSE truncation on these files; file-API reads are canonical and match recorded provenance

Q1_content_derived_verdict.evidence: verify_bundle reads only parsed bundle JSON; bundle_dir stored as metadata only, never used in verdict logic. Directory-rename test (test_mutating_valid_bundle_into_each_invalid_pattern_flips_verdict, renamed dirs renamed_fixture_0..6) and clean-room rename reproduction confirm name-independence. test_verifier_ignores_literal_expected_verdict_fields plus a deliberately-wrong expected_verdict decoy embedded in every fixture confirm expected-verdict literals are ignored.

Q2_failure_path_competence.evidence: 7 mutators flip a valid bundle into each specific invalid verdict; tests assert flip + non-empty failed_checks + verdict != VALID. Clean-room pytest: 6 passed. Independent probes show present-but-invalid sub-paths also fail correctly (P5 leakage detected=False, P6 baseline invoked=False, P7 source-pin open unresolved conflict, P8 leakage detected-but-not-consumed).

Q3_no_gate_pass_inflation.evidence: VALID_VERDICT='provenance_wellformed_only'; result carries no_gate_pass_claim=true and claim_ceiling; final_report.md has explicit 'What this does not prove'; CLI test scans 13 forbidden-claim terms in serialized output.

Q4_scope_boundary.evidence: Checks provenance-shape only. Does not adjudicate baseline-panel completeness or strength. Demonstrated by P2/P4 passing (see strongest_objection).

Q5_control_consumption.evidence: Every computed control row must appear in verdict_derivation.consumed_control_ids; orphan computed control -> invalid_control_computed_but_not_consumed (reproduced). control_consumption gate-input False forces derived 'blocked', enforced by verdict_derivation coupling.

Q6_replay_check.evidence: Rejects hash_only/stored_*_only flags; requires recompute booleans + mode=='recompute_from_serialized_state_and_observation'.
Q6_replay_check.caveat: Declaration/shape check on self-reported booleans, NOT actual recomputation. Inherent to a static bundle checker; within claim ceiling but must never be read as 'replay validated'.

Q7_source_pin_check.evidence: Rejects self_comparison_only; requires >=2 distinct authoritative channels with valid sha256; unresolved conflict / not-fail-closed -> invalid (P7 reproduced).
Q7_source_pin_check.caveat: Shape check; verifier does not itself re-hash source files. Fixtures use constant fabricated hashes (a*64) which is acceptable for shape testing only.

Q8_leakage_positive_control.evidence: Requires scanner provenance + >=1 positive control with same_admission_path + detected + consumed (id in consumed_leakage_positive_control_ids). P5 (not detected) and P8 (not consumed) -> invalid.

Q9_baseline_invocation.evidence: Listed/required baselines must have provenance rows carrying producer_function, inputs, run_id, aggregation, code_path_hash and invoked=True. P6 (invoked=False) -> invalid. Strongest baseline id must tie to an invoked row and be consumed by verdict derivation.

Q10_historical_negative_calibration_read.evidence: Read-only, produces no admission. But historical bundles use different filenames; acolb_001a and acp_bv_distribution_harness_001b_execution_001a both return invalid_schema_or_parse_failure (missing replay_report.json / source_pin_readback_report.json / leakage_scan.json / provenance_rows.jsonl). Substantive provenance checks will not engage without a separate, separately-audited schema shim. Any provenance_wellformed_only on historical data must NOT be read as admission.

strongest_objection.summary: The verifier cannot catch the exact failure class that produced the Route C false positive: metric degeneracy and omitted/mis-declared strongest fair baseline.
strongest_objection.probe_P2: shape-valid bundle with candidate_score=0.99 vs declared strongest_fair_baseline_score=0.05, delta=0.94, equivalence_band=0.01 -> provenance_wellformed_only (no margin/band adjudication performed).
strongest_objection.probe_P4: a second invoked baseline present, yet the weaker baseline still declared strongest_fair_baseline_id -> provenance_wellformed_only (no cross-baseline maximum check).
strongest_objection.implication: This is a provenance-SHAPE prefilter, not a baseline-immunity or admission gate. It must be paired with the separate BASELINE-IMMUNITY-ADMISSION-STANDARD enforcement, which it does not implement.

non_blocking_issues: replay/source-pin/leakage/consumption are declaration-shape checks on self-reported fields; verifier does not recompute or re-hash. Within claim ceiling but provenance_wellformed_only must never be read as 'replay/source verified'.
Dead branch verifier.py lines 248-249 (failure_recorded check unreachable; line 246 already guarantees consumed_by_final_verdict True). Cosmetic.

Committed tests omit present-but-invalid sub-paths (baseline invoked=False; leakage present-but-not-detected / not-consumed; source-pin open unresolved conflict). Code handles them (proven by probes) but tests do not lock them in -> regression risk.
Fixtures use constant fabricated hashes (a*64...); fine for shape testing, but committed fixtures never exercise a real source-pin hash mismatch.

P3: internal final_verdict='bundle_provenance_inputs_blocked' but shape-valid returns provenance_wellformed_only. Benign direction (does not false-green a shape-bad bundle); worth one-line documentation.
recommendation: Accept as local admission-support tooling / provenance-shape prefilter. Do NOT use as an admission gate or treat any provenance_wellformed_only as Gate pass, mechanism validity, baseline-immunity, or historical-evidence admission.
